name: triz
label: TRIZ: разрешение противоречий
instructions: Use TRIZ only for a verified causal contradiction, not for routine debugging, simple optimization or a problem settled by measurement or a known pattern. Prefer concrete mechanisms, existing resources, separation and a small falsifiable experiment. Keep terminology subordinate to the research object and never force a compromise or a framework worksheet.

procedure: Inspect the exact goal, available evidence, constraints and previous failures before ideation.
Apply the gate: identify one intervention whose mechanism both improves one metric and worsens another; otherwise use the direct method without a TRIZ narrative.
State the useful function, system boundary and an ideal final result as a direction rather than a promise.
Formulate the technical contradiction and, only when useful, the physical contradiction with opposite states for the same element.
Try separation in time, structure, condition or scale, then reuse existing resources before adding machinery.
Keep two to four concrete concepts with causal mechanism, preserved benefits, reused resource, residual risk and a falsification test.
Select the smallest reversible experiment that can reach every hard constraint, not merely the cheapest or most novel concept.
Run one feedback loop: check both benefits and any secondary contradiction, then revise once or stop.
preconditions: A candidate causal contradiction can be checked against evidence rather than invented for method use.
Direct debugging, measurement, a known theorem or a standard pattern has been considered first.
inputs: Evidence, measurements, previous attempts and available resources.
Candidate intervention and both affected metrics.
contract.output: A role-required result with a concrete contradiction model when applicable, comparison of a few mechanisms, the selected reversible experiment and residual trade-off. Implicit use returns the engineering or mathematical decision without visible TRIZ terminology.
stop_criteria: Stop when a testable concept or a direct non-TRIZ route is selected.
Stop rather than manufacture a contradiction, tour all principles or present a midpoint compromise as resolution.
examples: Success: separate exhaustive computation from final proof checking in different stages so both short feedback and kernel verification are preserved.
Failure: a routine nil-field panic is sent to ordinary debugging without a TRIZ worksheet or an invented architectural contradiction.
